description: Localization module for Select2 plugin for Icelandic language support (version 4.0.6-rc.1). Provides translations for UI messages such as input length warnings, no results, loading indicators, and maximum selections.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message indicating how many characters to delete when input is too long.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message indicating how many characters to add when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message shown while loading more results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message shown when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns message shown while search is in progress.
